YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r3.claim: The reminder is their honor, which whoever believes in the Qur'an receives.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r4.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r4.speaker: الحسن
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r4.claim: Hasan and Qatadah say the reminder is the Qur'an, which teaches what people should do and avoid, and what is forbidden and permitted.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r4.anchor: قال الحسن وقتادة: يعني القرآن، أنزلنا عليهم فيه ما يأتون، وما يتقون

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r5.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r5.speaker: author
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r5.claim: They turn away from what God has explained to them.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r6.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r6.speaker: قتادة
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r6.claim: Qatadah identifies the reminder they reject as the Qur'an.

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r7.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r7.speaker: السدي
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r7.claim: Al-Suddi reads both references to the reminder as their honor: they turn away from their own honor.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r7.anchor: وقال السدي: {بل أتيناهم بذكرهم} [المؤمنون: 71] : بشرفهم {فهم عن ذكرهم} [المؤمنون: 71] يعني عن شرفهم

YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r8.author: Yaḥyā b. Sallām
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r8.speaker: سفيان الثوري
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r8.claim: Sufyan al-Thawri cites 21:10, where the Book is described as containing their mention, and takes mention to mean honor.
YAHYA-SALLAM:v1p410/r8.anchor: قال يحيى: سمعت سفيان الثوري يذكر في هذه الآية: {لقد أنزلنا إليكم كتابا فيه ذكركم} [الأنبياء: 10] : فيه شرفكم

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p95/r5.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p95/r5.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p95/r5.claim: Here ذكر means the people's honor or distinction, not simply a reminder.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p95/r5.anchor: بل أتيناهم بذكرهم فهم عن ذكرهم معرضون [المؤمنون: 71]

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r1.claim: As in 23:70, al-ḥaqq can mean the Prophet’s revealed information, rulings, commands, and prohibitions, or universal reality, order, and balance; it can denote God’s laws for the cosmos and human conduct.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r1.anchor: Hak kavramı, 70. âyette olduğu gibi burada da Peygamber’in getirdiği bilgileri, hükümleri, buyruk ve yasakları

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r2.claim: These divine laws are objective and absolute, unaffected by human whim; they operate without deviation, or cosmic order and human conduct would collapse into anarchy.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r2.anchor: Âyete göre bu yasalar objektiftir; mutlaktır; insanların keyfi arzularına göre değişmez

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r3.claim: Under this universal law, an unbeliever can succeed by doing a task properly, while a believer who does it badly can be denied success; otherwise order, right, and justice would be impossible.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r3.anchor: bir inkârcı işini gerektiği şekilde yaparsa Allah onu başarıya ulaştırır, bir mümin işini iyi yapmazsa onu da başarıdan mahrum eder

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r4.claim: The author prefers rendering dhikr as honor and glory.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r4.anchor: bizim tercih ettiğimiz “şan ve şeref” anlamı verildiği gibi

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r5.speaker: Taberî ve Kurtubî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r5.claim: Commentators also allow dhikr to mean explanation or reminder; Tabari and Qurtubi are cited.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r5.anchor: “açıklama, hatırlatma” anlamına gelebileceği de belirtilmiştir (Taberî, XVIII, 43; Kurtubî, XII, 148)

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r6.claim: Both interpretations of dhikr refer to the Qur’an.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r6.anchor: Her iki anlamda da Kur’an-ı Kerîm kastedilmiştir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r7.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r7.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r7.claim: On the preferred reading, the Qur’an is a source of honor for humanity, so the Arab idolaters rejected their own source of dignity.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r7.anchor: bu yüce kitap insanlık için bir onur ve değer kaynağıdır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r8.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r8.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r8.claim: Islam, whose main source is the Qur’an, raised Arab influence beyond the peninsula and gave many peoples an honored history; they still owe much of their material and spiritual preservation to Islam.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:23:71/r8.anchor: Kur’an’ı ve İslâm’ı tanıyıp ilkelerini yaşayan başka birçok millet de bu sayede şanlı ve onurlu bir tarih yaşamıştır

DAMGHANI:v1p137/r14.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p137/r14.claim: The first sense here is God: in 23:71, the heavens and earth would be corrupted if God followed their desires; in 103:3, believers urge one another toward God alone.
DAMGHANI:v1p137/r14.anchor: فوجه منها : الحق يعني الله قوله تعالى في سورة المؤمنين " ولو اتبع الحق أهواءهم لفسدت السموات والأرض " يعني لو اتبع الله سبحانه أهواء المشركين
